newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call, no trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call, no trade.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange Thursday.
No barges traded versus none on Wednesday.
- Two barges, Ohio (Mt Vernon), next week, bid at 110 percent of tariff - no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Ohio (Cincinnati-Aurora), next week, bid 112-1/2 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- One barge, Illinois (Pekin), on station, no bid, offered 210 percent - no comparison.
- Two barges, Illinois, week of Feb 9, no bid, offered 190 percent - no comparison.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week of March, no bid, offered 150 percent - unchanged from similar offer.
- Five barges, mid-Mississippi, 30-day open, bid 160 percent, offered 165 - unchanged on both values.
- Five barges, scattered even mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), 30-day open, bid 160 percent - down 2-1/2 percentage points from bid, no offer.
